title: Saved Data pattern creation omits the selected organization request header
severity: S2: the authenticated pattern write violates the repository per-request organization contract even though the body carries the selected organization
priority: P1: confirm or repair the request contract before promoting member Data T08
preconditions: Use the frozen CI development v0.2.492 artifact and a signed-in non-admin member with a verified selected organization.
Create the disposable pattern through the Data side-panel Save pattern action.
reproduction: Inspect the native request observation in hosted run 38113237641: the POST to https://db.matrxserver.com/rest/v1/wbx_pattern returned HTTP 201, the body organization matched the selected organization, and headerOrganizationPresent was false.

At the exact product artifact source SHA, DataView passes organization_id to savePattern; savePattern uses the ordinary Supabase client; that client configures X-Client-Info but no X-Organization-Id global header.
expected: Every authenticated backend request carries X-Organization-Id matching the selected organization, and an organization-scoped write carries that same organization_id in its body.
actual: The captured authenticated pattern-create POST carried the selected organization_id in its body and returned 201, but had no X-Organization-Id header. Exact row readback found the saved pattern under the selected organization, and cleanup deleted that exact row.
cause: Confirmed shared transport defect: the three ordinary authenticated Supabase clients omitted X-Organization-Id on direct PostgREST requests. The Data Save body already carried the selected organization. Commit 4d0c4e58c attaches verified organization context at the shared Supabase HTTP boundary.
verification: Independent native peer inspected the exact hosted artifact and sanitized result; request observation reports body organization matched selected, headerOrganizationPresent=false, and HTTP 201.
Independent source inspection of the exact product artifact confirms the Save pattern path uses savePattern through the ordinary client; the client global headers only add X-Client-Info.

The hosted run remains partial. Automatic success, no_match, error, and manual Extract were observed; running was unverified. All four resource finals were valid; the temporary root selector was restored/read back and the exact owned row was deleted.
No code fix or rerun was performed in this bookkeeping task. Sol implementation-lane contract diagnosis is pending.
Shared-client source repair and real-SDK boundary tests independently reviewed; the original null-header reproduction now fails to reproduce.

Independent A/B peer verified native rendered running, success, no_match, failure and enabled manual Extract, exact saved-row readback/deletion and original selector restoration, exact ZIP digests and three valid hosted resource finals. Screenshots are generic and are not used as Data proof.
